Class ActiveGameState

java.lang.Object
org.engine.game.state.GameState
org.engine.game.state.ActiveGameState
Direct Known Subclasses:
ContractInProgress, WaitingForContractSelection
public abstract sealed class ActiveGameState extends GameState permits ContractInProgress, WaitingForContractSelection
Base for all non-terminal game states. Only these states accept moves, have a current player and legal moves, so the compiler enforces you cannot call those methods on a GameOver.

    • applyMove

      public abstract GameState applyMove(Move move)
      Applies a move to this state and returns the resulting state. Each subclass accepts only the moves legal in its phase.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the move type is not legal in the current phase
      IllegalMoveException - if the move violates game rules

    • withHands

      public abstract ActiveGameState withHands(Map<Player,Hand> newHands)
      Creates a copy of this state, replacing the current hands with the provided ones. Used by AI for determinization.
      Parameters:
      newHands - the hypothetical distribution of cards
      Returns:
      a new state identical to this one, but with the new hands
